Q4 — Systèmes / 1 pt #️⃣ Équations (inputs séparés)
Résoudre le système d'équations suivant :

\[ \begin{array}{l} {@eq1@} \\ {@eq2@} \end{array} \]
x = [[input:ans_x]] [[validation:ans_x]]
y = [[input:ans_y]] [[validation:ans_y]]
[[iframe width="100%" height="200px" scrolling="false"]] [[style]] body { margin: 0; padding: 0; font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, sans-serif; } .stack-keyboard-container { background: #f8fafc; border: 1px solid #e2e8f0; border-radius: 8px; padding: 16px; max-width: 600px; box-sizing: border-box; margin-top: 10px; } .stack-keyboard-title { font-size: 0.85rem; font-weight: 700; color: #475569; margin-bottom: 10px; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.05em; } .stack-keyboard-row { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 6px; align-items: center; margin-bottom: 8px; } .stack-keyboard-row:last-child { margin-bottom: 0; } .btn-ins { background: #ffffff !important; border: 1px solid #cbd5e1 !important; border-radius: 6px !important; color: #334155 !important; padding: 6px 12px !important; font-size: 0.9rem !important; font-weight: 600 !important; cursor: pointer !important; transition: all 0.15s ease !important; min-width: 38px !important; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,0.05) !important; user-select: none; } .btn-ins:hover { background: #eff6ff !important; border-color: #93c5fd !important; color: #2563eb !important; } .btn-ins:active { background: #dbeafe !important; } .btn-var { background: #f1f5f9 !important; border-color: #94a3b8 !important; color: #0f172a !important; font-style: italic; } .target-btn { background: #fff !important; border: 2px solid #cbd5e1 !important; border-radius: 6px !important; padding: 4px 10px !important; font-size: 0.8rem !important; font-weight: 700 !important; color: #64748b !important; cursor: pointer !important; transition: all 0.2s ease !important; } .active-target { background: #2563eb !important; color: #ffffff !important; border-color: #2563eb !important; box-shadow: 0 2px 4px rgba(37, 99, 235, 0.3) !important; } .sep { width: 1px; height: 28px; background: #e2e8f0; margin: 0 4px; } [[/style]]

[[script type="module"]] import {stack_js} from '[[cors src="stackjsiframe.js"/]]'; let currentTarget = null; function setupInput(name, btnId) { stack_js.request_access_to_input(name, true).then(function(input_id) { var input = document.getElementById(input_id); document.getElementById(btnId).addEventListener('click', function(e) { e.preventDefault(); currentTarget = input; document.querySelectorAll('.target-btn').forEach(b => b.classList.remove('active-target')); this.classList.add('active-target'); }); if(!currentTarget) { currentTarget = input; } }); } setupInput("ans_x", "target_x"); setupInput("ans_y", "target_y"); document.querySelectorAll('.btn-ins').forEach(function(btn){ btn.addEventListener('click', function(e){ e.preventDefault(); if(!currentTarget) return; var val = this.getAttribute('data-val'); var actuel = currentTarget.value || ''; var texteAvant = actuel.trimEnd(); var charPrecedent = texteAvant.length > 0 ? texteAvant.slice(-1) : null; var excl = [null, '=', '+', '-', '*', '/', '^', '(']; var estOp = /^[+\-*\/^)]/.test(val); var pref = ''; if (!excl.includes(charPrecedent) && !estOp && actuel.length > 0) { pref = '*'; } currentTarget.value = actuel + pref + val; currentTarget.dispatchEvent(new Event('change')); }); }); [[/script]] [[/iframe]]

generalfeedback.text:
🔑 Correction détaillée
Méthode par combinaison linéaire (ou addition) :
En additionnant les deux équations terme à terme, les y s'annulent :
\( (2x + y) + (x - y) = 5 + 4 \)
\( 3x = 9 \)
\( x = 3 \)

En remplaçant x par 3 dans la deuxième équation :
\( 3 - y = 4 \)
\( -y = 1 \)
\( y = -1 \)

Le couple solution est donc \( (3 ; -1) \).
